blocks.text: ANKARA, Turkey — An attacker armed with a shotgun killed eight people in three separate locations in western Turkey, on Thursday before he was apprehended, officials and news reports said. One other person was wounded in the shooting spree. The motive for the attack in Afyonkarahisar province was not immediately known. READ: Authorities foil 53
